text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking down the
hallway with
T.M. Opera O...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This skin of mine, so fine and soft, would
have me
heralded as this generation's
Cleopatra...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But alas! Such a hideous deformation has

appeared!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes fail you! Look here, at my
index finger!
choice_data_list: Doesn't it seem the same as always...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On closer inspection, I do see a
sore-looking spot
on the very tip of her
finger, but it's barely
noticeable.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Can you even comprehend it? No amount of grieving will resolve my woe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a tiny rash proves a major
problem to
Opera O. She couldn't be
more devastated.
